title: Feeding the four thousand
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child describes Matthew 15:32-38: after three days Jesus has compassion on the hungry crowd, takes seven loaves and a few fish, gives thanks, the disciples share it, all eat, seven baskets are left, four thousand men besides women and children; and lists ways to help the needy today.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the feeding of the five thousand.
floor.question: How many loaves did the boy give in the feeding of the five thousand?

representations: a list of ways to help
steps: The crowd has been with Jesus three days.
Seven loaves and a few fish; he gives thanks.

board.say: How many loaves and how many baskets?

board.do: Wait for the child to say seven and seven.
List four ways to help the needy today.

misconceptions.ask: How many loaves did Jesus have when he fed the four thousand?
misconceptions.repair: Make a two-column chart: four thousand and five thousand; fill loaves, fish, baskets.

misconceptions.ask: Why did Jesus feed the crowd?

listen_for: Giving only money and nothing else
misconceptions.ask: Which is a way of helping the needy?
misconceptions.repair: List five ways with the class: food, clothes, school items, time, prayer.

misconceptions.ask: How many basketfuls were left over after the four thousand ate (Matthew 15:37)?
misconceptions.repair: Make a two-column chart: 5,000 (five loaves, twelve baskets) and 4,000 (seven loaves, seven baskets).

checks.question: How many loaves did Jesus use to feed the four thousand?
Why did Jesus feed the crowd?
